The question, in words

Does the error of the estimate shrink as one over the square root of the sample size?

What we expected, and why

The protocol expected the square-root law.

What we did

We ran the estimator at every size.

What happened

The law held (R-4).

What we learned

The slope pools every size, so it is a robust test.

What this does not show

  • Anything about another estimator.
